model_policy: Use OFFDATA_CRON_PROVIDER/OFFDATA_CRON_MODEL when supplied; otherwise Hermes cron.model. Never silently inherit an unqualified paid model.

jobs.name: OFFDATA Frontier Scan
jobs.prompt: Scan current technology, science, open-source, API, hardware and cost-curve changes. Record only novel signals and candidate enabling changes in Venture Brain; do not create ventures merely because a trend exists.

jobs.name: OFFDATA Trend Scan
jobs.prompt: Scan current behavior, workflow, regulatory and spending changes. Record evidence-backed signals and contradictions. Avoid repeating the prior run.

jobs.name: OFFDATA Brief 0700
jobs.prompt: Send the owner a concise OFF/DATA portfolio brief: new opportunities, ventures by stage, experiments, customer evidence, revenue/cost, pending approvals, risks and next decisions. Do not invent status.

jobs.name: OFFDATA Brief 1200
jobs.prompt: Send the owner the noon OFF/DATA delta brief: what materially changed since 07:00, approvals/risks/deals needing attention and current experiments.

jobs.name: OFFDATA Brief 1600
jobs.prompt: Send the owner the 16:00 OFF/DATA delta brief: customer/commercial movement, spend/risks, build/validation progress and decisions required.

jobs.name: OFFDATA Brief 0000
jobs.prompt: Send the owner the end-of-day OFF/DATA brief with AAR-worthy outcomes, cash/revenue/spend delta, killed/pivoted ventures and what will run overnight.

jobs.name: OFFDATA Approval Chaser
jobs.prompt: Check pending owner-required action/capital approvals. If none are pending, return no message. If any are pending, send a compact chaser listing ID, venture, action, amount/risk and age. Never auto-approve.

jobs.name: OFFDATA Customer Health
jobs.prompt: Review active customers, promises, delivery obligations, health, churn/renewal signals and unresolved support issues. Create operational Kanban work where needed; escalate material risk.

jobs.name: OFFDATA Finance Reconciliation
jobs.prompt: Reconcile provider receipts, invoices/payments/refunds and Venture Brain journal. Surface unmatched effects and update finance exceptions. Never manufacture entries to force balance.

jobs.name: OFFDATA Weekly Portfolio
jobs.prompt: Run the Sunday portfolio tournament. Compare evidence, economics, learning value, capital exposure and opportunity cost. Recommend continue/pivot/hold/kill and capital reallocations; owner-required decisions remain pending.

jobs.name: OFFDATA Calibration
jobs.prompt: Resolve due forecasts, calculate calibration/Brier summaries by role/model/task class and identify systematic over/under-confidence. Record model evaluation candidates.

jobs.name: OFFDATA Recursive Learning
jobs.prompt: Review AARs and outcomes across ventures. Classify FACT/PRIOR/PROCEDURE/POLICY_PROPOSAL. Draft Skill improvements for procedural lessons; never silently modify evidence/gate/finance/authority/security policy.
